items.title: Indiana football starting RG Joe Brunner out for the season
items.summary:
Indiana football offensive lineman Joe Brunner "blew his ACL" and will miss the remainder of the season, head coach Curt Cignetti announced Monday during his weekly media availability.

The redshirt senior started each of Indiana's first nine games at right guard but sustained the ACL injury in practice last week. Brunner was a late addition to the Hoosiers' injury report ahead of Saturday's contest against USC, being listed as out Thursday.
